question: What chapter of the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa text concludes with this colophon?
premises: The text is identified as Aṃśumān in Kāśyapa.
The chapter is named the chapter on the origin of colors.
inference: This marks the end of the eighty-eighth chapter on the origin of colors in the Aṃśumān Kāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus, in the Aṃśumān of Kāśyapa, this is the eighty-eighth chapter on the origin of colors.
